title: Institutional Policy seam: operative artefact selection is external to Brand Governance
summary: Institutional Policy v0.8 owns publication identity, authority, effective time, lifecycle, deployment topology, progressive rollout, promotion evidence and rollback evidence for fixed reviewed artefacts. Brand Governance consumes an exact resolved rule-set payload but does not copy those algorithms.
invariants: Operative policy is FIXED_REVIEWABLE_VERSIONED_ARTIFACT, never runtime LLM generation.
Publication/deployment authority is not Brand domain authority.
Promotion and rollback gates are deterministic deployment-governance evidence, not customer/domain evidence.
Automatic rollback re-evaluates supplied observations and does not trust caller-authored assessments.
Manual authorized rollback remains available independently.
Brand Governance owns domain disposition semantics; Institutional Policy owns which exact reviewed version is operative.

provenance.claim: Institutional Policy deployment/governance ownership, rollback evidence and fixed-artifact invariant.
Evidence-gated progressive promotion and domain-evidence separation.
Post-promotion rollback is independent fixed deployment-governance evidence.
